review_type: Actual image inspection of every assigned full page
method: Each local PNG was opened with view_image and emitted at full-page size for visual inspection. Text extraction was not substituted for viewing.
checked: body text and visible page continuation
all equation rows, fractions, exponents and equation numbers
running headers, page numbers and bottom margins
absence of clipping, overlaps, missing glyphs and visible unresolved references
